build.scope: New clean aircraft and luggage asset build, no Site checkout touched

aircraft.method: Procedural Blender authoring after bounded free-source search found no directly downloadable, license-clear, photoreal passenger aircraft without an add-on/account gate
aircraft.geometry: Smoothed surface-of-revolution fuselage, swept airfoil wings, winglets, horizontal and vertical tails, modeled nacelles, intake rings, fan blades, cockpit and cabin windows, doors, landing gear, tires, hubs, lights, antennas
aircraft.livery: White aluminum, navy tail, blue belly region, clear editable UNITED wordmark based on the sourced United Airlines 1998 SVG reference, trademark remains subject to owner rights
aircraft.mark_rendering: Native editable text mesh is exported for reliable GLB visibility, official SVG is retained under sources/united_logo as the source reference

airline-avianca.glb.method: Copied validated aircraft mesh with named livery materials replaced, clear editable avianca wordmark based on sourced Avianca 2013 SVG reference
airline-avianca.glb.license_note: Wikimedia Commons lists the file as public domain, trademark rights remain with Avianca
airline-avianca.glb.livery_roles: Avianca Red tail and wordmark, Avianca Wine Belly, white aluminum airframe
airline-avianca.glb.mark_rendering: Native editable text mesh is exported for reliable GLB visibility, official SVG is retained under sources/airline_logos

airline-aircanada.glb.method: Copied validated aircraft mesh with named livery materials replaced, clear editable AIR CANADA wordmark based on sourced Air Canada SVG reference
airline-aircanada.glb.license_note: Wikimedia Commons lists the file as public domain, trademark rights remain with Air Canada
airline-aircanada.glb.livery_roles: Air Canada Red tail and logo, Air Canada Grey Belly, white aluminum airframe
airline-aircanada.glb.mark_rendering: Native editable text mesh is exported for reliable GLB visibility, official SVG is retained under sources/airline_logos

luggage-black-ribbed.geometry: Beveled shell, six raised ribs per face, edge seals, corner guards, telescopic rails and handle, four wheels, hubs, sticker

luggage-cognac-duffel.geometry: Rounded leather body, end seams, zipper, carry handles, shoulder strap, brass feet and luggage tag

luggage-vintage-suitcase.method: Imported suitcase 01 only from a derived 1K glTF copy of the Poly Haven source
luggage-vintage-suitcase.transformation: Isolated plain suitcase 01, normalized to 1.0 m height, centered X/Y, base translated to z=0, derived 1K PBR maps embedded in the export
luggage-vintage-suitcase.source_preserved: Original 2K glTF and maps remain under sources/polyhaven_vintage_suitcase
